skill.name: Observability
skill.description: Logs, metrics, and traces as complementary signals, high-cardinality dimensions, and the instrumentation budget.
skill.summary: Metrics answer is-it-broken, logs answer why, traces answer where; exemplars bridge them. Cardinality multiplies across labels (10x10 = 10^10 series); never label user_id, request_id, IP. Percentiles, not averages, for SLIs. Alert on SLO burn: 14.4x over 1h AND 5m to page, 6x over 6h AND 30m to ticket. Tail-sample to keep 100% of errors; sample at the collector before you pay for storage.
